Run an EHR processing pipeline for one source

Source: R/pipeline.R
run_one_source.Rd

Import a cohort, load its tables into PostgreSQL, extract concepts, and build harmonized output tables. Select pipeline stages with stages and configure their behavior with the option groups below.

Usage

run_one_source(
  src_name = NULL,
  db_name = NULL,
  base_dir = NULL,
  engine = c("postgres", "duckdb"),
  raw_data_root = NULL,
  stages = NULL,
  ...,
  cohort_selection = cohort_selection_options(),
  windows = window_options(),
  loading = loading_options(),
  enrichment = enrichment_options(),
  concepts = concept_options(),
  harmonization = harmonization_options(),
  execution = execution_options()
)

Arguments

src_name

Character string identifying a registered source, for example "mimic_iv_demo" or "eicu". If NULL, use the active project configuration, falling back to "mimic_iv_demo".

db_name

Character string naming the PostgreSQL database. If NULL, use the active project configuration, falling back to "rendehr".

base_dir

Character string giving the project directory. If NULL, use the active project configuration, falling back to the working directory.

engine

Character string, "postgres" (default) or "duckdb". With "duckdb" the source is loaded into its DuckDB file (ehr_paths()$duckdb_path) and raw modifications, cohort_info and concept extraction run there; the PostgreSQL-only stages (cohort annotations, comorbidities, ISS, external concepts, harmonization) are skipped and PostgreSQL is not used. Cohort import uses DuckDB with either engine.

raw_data_root

Character string giving the parent directory of the raw source files. Files for a source are read from raw_data_root/src_name. If NULL, use the project configuration or data/source_data under base_dir.

stages

Character vector of stage names, or NULL for the default stages in the Stages section of run_one_source(). Selected stages run in pipeline order, regardless of their order in this vector. Required inputs for omitted stages must exist.

...

Named arguments accepted for compatibility with the ungrouped interface. See pipeline_compatibility for supported stage switches and rules for combining these arguments with option groups.

cohort_selection

Named list from cohort_selection_options() specifying cohort membership, identifier keys, and the source tables to import.

windows

Named list from window_options() specifying a custom SQL file or function for constructing observation windows during cohort import.

loading

Named list from loading_options() specifying import resources, CSV parsing, cache use, and PostgreSQL loading options.

enrichment

Named list from enrichment_options() specifying cohort classification, analysis level, comorbidity maps, and injury-score settings.

concepts

Named list from concept_options() specifying concept layers, concept names, supplemental definitions, and user or external SQL settings.

harmonization

Named list from harmonization_options() specifying which harmonized tables to build and their names.

execution

Named list from execution_options() specifying overwrite, progress reporting, and continuation after a stage fails.

Value

Invisibly, a data frame with one row per attempted stage and columns:

stage

Character stage label.

status

"success" or "failed".

seconds

Numeric elapsed time in seconds.

message

Error message, or an empty string after success.

A call that stops with an error does not return this data frame.

Details

Source files must be available locally. Stages that use PostgreSQL require connection credentials configured with load_credentials(). Project paths and source configuration are resolved with ehr_paths().

Option groups may also be ordinary named lists. Unspecified options use the defaults of the corresponding stage. Supplying options does not select a stage. For example, concepts = concept_options(layers = "flat") limits concept extraction to flat concepts; use stages = "run_concepts" to run only that stage.

Stages

The table gives the execution order and defaults when stages = NULL and no compatibility stage switches are supplied. The scid cohort profile additionally enables comorbidity and injury-severity scoring.

StageOperationDefault
cache_raw_parquetCache raw tables as ParquetNo
import_cohortSelect and materialize a cohortYes
run_dbLoad cohort tables into PostgreSQLYes
run_raw_modsApply required source transformationsYes
build_window_tablesCreate observation windows when neededYes
build_cohort_annotationsBuild cohort annotationsNo
build_cohort_infoBuild cohort informationYes
run_comorbiditiesCompute comorbidity scoresSCID profile
run_issCompute injury-severity scoresSCID profile
run_conceptsExtract source-specific conceptsYes
run_external_conceptsRun external SQL separatelyNo
run_harmonized_tablesBuild harmonized output tablesYes

Output and errors

Stages create or update project files and database tables. The default is to stop when a stage fails. Set execution_options(skip_on_error = TRUE) to continue to subsequent stages; failure of required raw transformations always stops the pipeline. concept_options(dry_run = TRUE) previews concept SQL only; other selected stages still execute.

See also

pipeline_options, run_concepts(), run_one_source_test()

Examples

# Configure a concept-only run without opening a database connection.
flat_only <- concept_options(layers = "flat")

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# These calls require local source data and project/database configuration.
run_one_source("mimic_iv_demo", base_dir = "project")

# Rebuild only flat concepts for an existing cohort.
run_one_source(
  "mimic_iv_demo",
  base_dir = "project",
  stages = "run_concepts",
  concepts = flat_only
)
} # }
